rate_plans_charge_value_check.name: rate_plans_charge_value_check
rate_plans_charge_value_check.value:
("rate_plans"."cancel_charge" = 'percent'
             AND "rate_plans"."cancel_charge_value" IS NOT NULL
             AND "rate_plans"."cancel_charge_value" BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
          OR ("rate_plans"."cancel_charge" <> 'percent' AND "rate_plans"."cancel_charge_value" IS NULL)

rate_plan_rates_stay_range_check.name: rate_plan_rates_stay_range_check
rate_plan_rates_stay_range_check.value: "rate_plan_rates"."min_stay" IS NULL OR "rate_plan_rates"."max_stay" IS NULL OR "rate_plan_rates"."max_stay" >= "rate_plan_rates"."min_stay"
